entities.name: Joaquín Velázquez de León
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joaquín Velázquez de León was a 19th-century conservative politician of Mexico who served as the founding Minister of Colonization, Industry and Commerce (1853–1855) in the cabinet of Antonio López de Santa Anna, as minister of State of Emperor Maximilian of Mexico (1864–1866) and as chargé d'affaires of Mexico to the United States (1842).
